messages:
Ana: quick async ping — PR #4123 ready except a couple tiny style nits I addressed in a follow-up commit. asking for a merge slot tomorrow ~11:30am PST if CI stays green. short summary: renamed `session_id` -> `sessionID` for consistency and ran gofumpt; one generated proto tag reorder was fixed too.

Ana: diff snippet: ```
- type Session struct {
-   session_id string
- }
+ type Session struct {
+   sessionID string
+ }
```

Tom: can you paste the failing linter message you saw earlier? want to confirm nothing else will pop in the premerge.

Ana: the earlier failure was a gofumpt ordering complaint from pre-commit: `imports are not grouped` and one trailing comma in a generated composite lit. fixed by running `gofumpt -w` and reformatting the proto-gen file.

Josh: thanks — looks small. can you run `make fmt` and push? i can take the merge if CI is green. also pls add a short changelog line under `CHANGELOG/unreleased.md` since it's a naming tweak.

Ana: done — ran `make fmt` and added changelog line. pushed `fix/style-run-2` to the branch.

ci-bot: build started for refs/heads/fix/style-run-2 (linux/amd64, go1.20)

Liz: quick review — lgtm for the naming change, please squash the minor whitespace commit if it helps a clean history. otherwise :+1:

Tom: if ci-bot comes back green i'm happy to merge during the 11:30 slot. can we hold off on auto-merge? i'll do the manual merge and watch the canary.

ci-bot: all checks passed (unit, lint, integration). build 8421 ✅

Ana: perfect — i'll disable auto-merge and leave the branch. thanks everyone.

Tom: grabbing merge slot 11:30 PST tomorrow. i'll re-run quick smoke after landing and rollback if anything odd shows up. :thumbsup:

Josh: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on the style fixes. small reminder: add the `//nolint:lll` if any generated lines exceed linter limits next time so we don't block CI.

Ana: noted, will do. thanks all!
